title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with edit permission for a container or workbook task could store…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with edit permissions on container or workbook tasks can inject attacker-controlled HTML into notes. When viewed by users with view permissions, this can lead to execution of unauthorized JavaScript in their browsers, potentially exposing data and allowing actions via the authenticated session. This occurs because active content is not properly neutralized before rendering in Mission Control.
